title: 第一卷 第13章 只要我觉得，那就揍你！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

闫振东有些尴尬地走进小房间。

“耀宗，我刚去找过闫忠国了。隔壁房间的玻璃窗，好像真不是他砸的！”闫振东走到闫耀宗身边，也没个椅子，只能站着。

闫耀宗自顾自地吃着，好似没听到闫振东的话，还给傻婆娘夹了一大块野猪肉。

傻婆娘抿嘴笑着。

闫耀宗很喜欢看傻婆娘吃饭，每一口饭都细嚼慢咽。

见闫耀宗不搭理自己，闫振东抬手挠了挠后脑勺，道：“耀宗，你说，不是闫忠国，会是谁？我是真想不出了！”

闫耀宗放下碗筷，看向闫振东，道：“我都跟你说了，没证据，别乱猜。”

“我这不是太生气了嘛！”

“你生什么气？砸破的玻璃窗是村委会的，又不是你家的。”

你要是这么讲，这天就没法聊了。

七八分钟后，傻婆娘吃完饭，放下碗筷。

闫耀宗便把碗筷放回挂篮，递给杵在旁边的闫振东，道：“天这么黑，你回去路上小心点。”

“行吧！”

闫振东闷闷不乐地接过挂篮，道：“那我就先回去了。”

“嗯！”

闫振东提着挂篮，转身向着小房间外走去。

走出村委会，闫振东扭头向着二楼的窗口看去，觉得闫耀宗的态度太奇怪了。

回想昨天在溪山遇到叶龙他们要抢野猪肉，闫耀宗也是先‘认怂’，然后陡然出手，把叶龙他们打趴下。

今儿个去上叶村，闫耀宗又是一声不吭地把叶龙父子俩揍趴下。

咬人的狗。

从来不叫。

闫振东摇摇头，低声嘀咕，“这事情，不能就这么算了。明早，我就去找村长，让他给耀宗做主！”

言罢，闫振东便冒着暴雨，大步离去。

村委会二楼。

闫耀宗跟傻婆娘坐在楼梯的台阶上，看着外边哗啦啦下着的暴雨。

傻婆娘的脑袋靠在闫耀宗的胳膊上，抬着右手，五根如葱手指，稍稍弯曲，好似在抓什么东西。

晚上九点多。

傻婆娘躺在两张办公桌拼凑的‘床’上，闭着眼睛，嘴角带着笑意。

闫耀宗借着煤油灯，看着傻婆娘长长的睫毛，嘴角慢慢地扬起，露出温柔的笑意。

抬手轻轻地抚摸着傻婆娘的脸颊，闫耀宗的声音低不可闻，“媳妇，我说过，这辈子，会守着你，护着你，宠着你……”

闫耀宗的声音越来越轻，慢慢地收回手，迈步向着小房间外走去。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yan Zhendong walked into the small room with some embarrassment.

"Yao Zong, I just went to see Yan Zhongguo. It seems that he didn't smash the glass window in the next room!" Yan Zhendong walked to Yan Yaozong. There was no chair, so he could only stand.

Yan Yaozong was eating by himself, as if he didn't hear Yan Zhendong's words, and gave the silly woman a large piece of wild boar meat.

The silly woman pursed her lips and smiled.

Yan Yaozong liked to watch the silly woman eating, chewing every mouthful of rice carefully.

Seeing that Yan Yaozong ignored him, Yan Zhendong raised his hand and scratched the back of his head and said: "Yao Zong, tell me, if it's not Yan Zhongguo, who could it be? I really can't think of it!"

Yan Yaozong put down his bowl and chopsticks, looked at Yan Zhendong, and said, "I told you, don't make random guesses without evidence."

"I'm not too angry!"

"Why are you angry? The broken glass window belongs to the village committee, not your home."

If you say that, there will be no conversation today.

Seven or eight minutes later, the silly woman finished her meal and put down her bowls and chopsticks.

Yan Yaozong put the bowls and chopsticks back into the hanging basket, handed them to Yan Zhendong who was standing next to him, and said, "It's so dark, so be careful on your way back."

"Okay!"

Yan Zhendong took the hanging basket glumly and said, "Then I'll go back first."

"Yeah!"

Yan Zhendong carried the hanging basket, turned around and walked out of the small room.

After walking out of the village committee, Yan Zhendong turned to look at the window on the second floor, feeling that Yan Yaozong's attitude was too strange.

Recalling that he met Ye Long and the others in Xishan yesterday and wanted to rob wild boar meat, Yan Yaozong also gave in first and then suddenly took action and beat Ye Long and the others to the ground.

Today I went to Shangye Village alone, and Yan Yaozong beat Ye Long and his son to the ground again without saying a word.

Biting dog.

Never bark.

Yan Zhendong shook his head and murmured in a low voice, "We can't just let this matter go. Tomorrow morning, I will go to the village chief and let him make the decision for Yaozong!"

After saying this, Yan Zhendong braved the heavy rain and strode away.

The second floor of the village committee.

Yan Yaozong and Silly Wife were sitting on the steps of the stairs, looking at the heavy rain falling outside.

The silly woman's head rested on Yan Yaozong's arm, and she raised her right hand with five onion-like fingers, slightly bent, as if she was grabbing something.

It's about nine o'clock in the evening.

The silly woman was lying on the 'bed' made up of two desks, with her eyes closed and a smile on her lips.

Yan Yaozong looked at the silly woman's long eyelashes with the help of a kerosene lamp, and slowly raised the corners of his mouth, revealing a gentle smile.

Raising his hand to gently caress the silly woman's cheek, Yan Yaozong's voice was inaudible, "Daughter-in-law, I said that in this life, I will guard you, protect you, and pamper you..."

Yan Yaozong's voice became softer and softer, and he slowly retracted his hand and walked out of the small room.
